title: ITEM GIVER GUI PAGE 2
script:
-- Criação do GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ItemA60 = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ItemRock = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ItemDread = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ItemJeff = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ItemDupe = Instance.new("TextButton") -- Novo botão

-- Propriedades do GUI
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.Name = "CustomGUI"

Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.05, 0) -- GUI ainda mais para cima
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 350) -- Ajustado para comportar o novo botão

CloseButton.Parent = ScreenGui
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 10) -- Canto superior direito
CloseButton.Text = "Close UI"

ItemA60.Parent = Frame
ItemA60.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
ItemA60.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ItemA60.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 10)
ItemA60.Text = "A-60 Plushie"

ItemRock.Parent = Frame
ItemRock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
ItemRock.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ItemRock.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 70)
ItemRock.Text = "Rock"

ItemDread.Parent = Frame
ItemDread.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
ItemDread.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ItemDread.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 130)
ItemDread.Text = "Dread Plushie"

ItemJeff.Parent = Frame
ItemJeff.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
ItemJeff.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ItemJeff.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 190)
ItemJeff.Text = "Jeff the Killer Plushie"

ItemDupe.Parent = Frame
ItemDupe.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
ItemDupe.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ItemDupe.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 250)
ItemDupe.Text = "Dupe Plushie" -- Novo botão

-- Função para fechar o GUI
CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Função para pegar o A-60 Plushie
ItemA60.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local item = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://70691771935300")[1]
    item.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
end)

-- Função para pegar o Rock
ItemRock.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local item = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://129772614047585")[1]
    item.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
end)

-- Função para pegar o Dread Plushie
ItemDread.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local item = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://13071801863")[1]
    item.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
end)

-- Função para pegar o Jeff the Killer Plushie
ItemJeff.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local item = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://13069619857")[1]
    item.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
end)

-- Função para pegar o Dupe Plushie
ItemDupe.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local dread = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://123823160664220")[1]
    dread.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
end)
